text: Entry Requirements Senior high school diploma,non-Chinese.Students with no basic knowledge of Chinese language can apply to the Chinese major.Students with basic knowledge of Chinese language can enroll as transfer students.Students with HSK 4 can apply for the second year.Students with HSK 4(180 or morel) and HSKK intermediate can apply for the first year of Chinese International Education. Students who want to study in other departments(besides SCS)should have HSK 5 195 or more. Applicants under the age of 18 shall submit relevat ducuments of entrusted legal guardians in China. After obtaining the X1 visa,it is necessary to obtain the certification documents of birth certificate at the Chinese Embassy abroad.If there is no parental information on the birth certificate,the family relationship certificate certified by the Chinese Embassy shall be prvided, and the students can only enter the school after submitting them at the time of enrollment. Note: The cost of one academic year (undergraduate course) is 21800 yuan. The fee includes registration fee, tuition fee and miscellaneous fee, which shall be paid at one time upon enrollment.
